        private transient ValueState<Boolean> emittedState;
        private transient ValueState<Boolean> timerRegistered;

        @Override
        public void open(Configuration parameters) {
            maxState = getRuntimeContext().getState(
                    new ValueStateDescriptor<>("max", Integer.class));
            finishedState = getRuntimeContext().getState(
                    new ValueStateDescriptor<>("finished", Boolean.class));
            emittedState = getRuntimeContext().getState(
                    new ValueStateDescriptor<>("emitted", Boolean.class));
            timerRegistered = getRuntimeContext().getState(
                    new ValueStateDescriptor<>("timer", Boolean.class));
        }

        private void ensureTimer(Context ctx) throws Exception {
            Boolean t = timerRegistered.value();
            if (t == null || !t) {
                // Watermark advances to Long.MAX_VALUE at end of a bounded
                // input; use MAX_VALUE - 1 so the timer definitely fires.
                ctx.timerService().registerEventTimeTimer(Long.MAX_VALUE - 1);
                timerRegistered.update(true);
            }
        }

        private void tryEmit(Long jobId, Collector<String> out) throws Exception {
            Boolean em = emittedState.value();
            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(em)) return;
            Integer m = maxState.value();
            Boolean f = finishedState.value();
            if (m != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(f)) {
                out.collect("(" + jobId + "," + m + ")");
                emittedState.update(true);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void processElement1(Tuple2<Long, Integer> value,
                                    Context ctx,
                                    Collector<String> out) throws Exception {
            Integer cur = maxState.value();
            if (cur == null || value.f1 > cur) {
                maxState.update(value.f1);
            }
            ensureTimer(ctx);
            tryEmit(ctx.getCurrentKey(), out);
        }

        @Override
        public void processElement2(Long jobId,
                                    Context ctx,
                                    Collector<String> out) throws Exception {
            finishedState.update(true);
            ensureTimer(ctx);
            tryEmit(ctx.getCurrentKey(), out);
        }

        @Override
        public void onTimer(long timestamp,
                            OnTimerContext ctx,
                            Collector<String> out) throws Exception {
            tryEmit(ctx.getCurrentKey(), out);
        }
    }
